title: Shoot before script review
detect_signals: Production lists no link to script review
Nothing stops the shoot from starting before the scripts are final
sim_effect: Production can start as soon as it is placed; if it starts before script review is finished, its full effort becomes hidden rework, and the reshoot waits for the reviewed scripts.
accepted_fixes: Restore the link: production waits for script review
Make the shoot depend on the finished script review and move the shoot if the dates clash
partial_fixes: Add a note to check the scripts before the shoot
Ask Perrick to confirm the scripts informally before filming
concept: Dependencies: work that consumes an approval must wait for it
sop_ref: Media SOP 3M: scripts are reviewed and finalized before production days
explanation: Filming scripts that haven't been reviewed means reshoots once the review changes them. The link keeps the shoot behind the review, and if the dates then clash, move the shoot, not the review.
note: Planted on the three original projects; the plants name tasks the newer projects do not have.
